beats.subline: Friday, August 21, 2026 close — stocks rebounded across the board, though all three indexes still closed lower for the week amid persistent Treasury-yield stress.
beats.body: Healthcare and crypto-linked shares led the bounce as bitcoin surged 22% for the week to top $76,900, while the 30-year Treasury yield held near 5.27% despite the Treasury doubling its long-bond buyback operations.

beats.headline: US-Canada trade talks collapse, triggering 50% tariffs on a swath of Canadian goods
beats.body: Trade talks between Washington and Ottawa collapsed late Friday, prompting the US to invoke the never-before-used Section 338 of the 1930 Tariff Act and impose 50% tariffs just after midnight Saturday on roughly $20 billion of Canadian goods including hockey sticks, building materials, liquor and clothing; Prime Minister Mark Carney called the outcome insufficient and vowed Canada would match the tariffs dollar for dollar, while energy, potash and critical minerals were carved out.

beats.headline: US Navy patrol plane transits Taiwan Strait days before planned Xi-Trump summit
beats.body: A US 7th Fleet P-8A Poseidon flew through international airspace over the Taiwan Strait on Friday in a mission the Navy said demonstrates commitment to a 'free and open Indo-Pacific'; Chinese forces tracked the aircraft throughout, and the transit comes weeks before Xi Jinping's expected visit to the US to meet President Trump as the two governments try to stabilize ties strained by Taiwan, trade and tech disputes.

beats.headline: CENTCOM says it has redirected 68 ships enforcing renewed Iran blockade
beats.body: US Central Command says American forces have redirected 68 commercial vessels, disabled three and boarded two since resuming the naval blockade of Iranian ports in mid-July, with more than 20 warships supporting the effort; Iran's parliament speaker says Tehran won't reopen the Strait of Hormuz until the blockade ends and its frozen assets are released.

beats.headline: Marine Corps fields Bayonet underwater robots to hunt mines before troops hit the beach
beats.body: The Marine Corps has begun fielding Bayonet Autonomous Underwater Ground Vehicles — tracked crawlers that cross the seafloor, push through six-foot breaking surf and climb onto the beach — letting explosive ordnance disposal teams survey and clear the most dangerous stretch of an amphibious approach without first putting Marines in the water; the Bayonet 250 is now entering the Corps' inventory under a Littoral Explosive Ordnance Neutralization contract with Greensea IQ.

beats.headline: Anthropic targets an IPO that could match or beat SpaceX's record $86 billion raise
beats.body: Anthropic has confidentially filed a draft S-1 with the SEC and could go public as soon as this month, people familiar with the matter told Bloomberg, with the Claude maker's annualized revenue reportedly reaching roughly $65 billion in July as enterprise spending on Claude and AI agents accelerated; the company is working with Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan and now Citigroup on the offering.

beats.headline: Bears QB Tyson Bagent held out of Bengals game with lingering hamstring injury
beats.body: Head coach Ben Johnson said backup quarterback Tyson Bagent, who strained his hamstring in the preseason opener against Cleveland, did not travel with the team for the joint practices and preseason game at Cincinnati and remains 'week-to-week'; Case Keenum and Miller Moss are handling the bulk of the quarterback snaps in his absence.
